verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a built-in AI assistant ("New Relic AI") that lets users ask questions, troubleshoot issues, explore telemetry, and get help writing queries in plain language, plus a hint at moving toward automated remediation — this is a genuine in-product AI assistant, not just an API/MCP add-on. However, evidence is limited to a couple of vendor doc snippets with no independent/hands-on validation of its reliability or scope in production use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's real-world effectiveness, and clearer documentation of its task-delegation/automation boundaries beyond a single teaser line.
